# Quantum Temporal Readout

> Estimate Pauli expectations from destructive detector reports with temporal memory, including settings where every individual report has zero contrast.

## Learn the mechanism

- [Overview](README.md): question, results, scope and links.
- [Worked example](learning/WORKED_EXAMPLE.md): shared fair polarity and reference calibration.
- [Learning guide](learning/README.md): the Watrous source and 30-milestone map.

## Read the proofs

- [Detector model](science/model.md): causal detector, joint POVM, Pauli twirling, pilot-conditioned contrast and strict temporal hierarchy.
- [Calibration](science/calibration.md): history-conditioned martingale certificate and simultaneous Pauli acquisition.
- [Context cost](science/context-cost.md): collision-based reference decoder and matching minimax bound. The stationary uniform-context submodel has one unknown sign per context.
- [Physical model](science/physical-model.md): shared phase drift, finite delay and control accuracy.
- [Related work](references/RELATED_WORK.md): inherited twirling, calibration and detector access models.
- [Verification](verification/README.md): checks, commands and boundaries.

All detector calls are charged. Detector-side memory may be quantum. The experimenter uses fresh copies, trusted product controls and known pilot probes. The exact hierarchy witness itself uses classical detector memory.
